_about.corpus: olist schema -- real Brazilian e-commerce data, 1,451,414 rows
_about.authored: 2026-08-25 (cycle 007), scripts/gen_multiturn_fixture.py -- every SQL ground truth executed live via data.run_select before commit; the one docs-route ground truth (mt_06 T1) is the same value and same expected_chunk_ids already established and scored by fixtures/golden/phase_e1.json's e1_doc_002, reused rather than re-invented.
_about.self_authored_warning: Self-authored, same class of caveat as olist.json/olist_hard.json's own _about.self_authored_warning.
_about.design_note: Per-turn SQL-generation difficulty is deliberately kept in the EASY range (single-table or a 2-3 table join, matching olist.json's own profile, not olist_hard.json's) so a QM failure on a REWRITTEN question is attributable to the rewrite/multi-turn mechanism this fixture exists to test, not confounded with ordinary SQL-generation difficulty this project has already separately characterized (AGENT_HANDOFF.md §6: 88.9% easy / 50.0% hard).

turns.text: How many orders included an item from seller 6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) n FROM olist.order_items WHERE seller_id='6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0'

turns.text: Just the delivered ones?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) n FROM olist.order_items oi
                JOIN olist.orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id
                WHERE oi.seller_id='6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0' AND o.order_status='delivered'

turns.text: And how many of those were paid by credit card?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) n FROM olist.order_items oi
                JOIN olist.orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id
                JOIN olist.order_payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id
                WHERE oi.seller_id='6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0' AND o.order_status='delivered' AND p.payment_type='credit_card'

turns.text: How many orders were paid using credit card?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) n FROM olist.order_payments WHERE payment_type='credit_card'

turns.text: And how many of those had more than 6 installments?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) n FROM olist.order_payments WHERE payment_type='credit_card' AND payment_installments > 6

turns.text: Just the ones with a payment value over 200?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) n FROM olist.order_payments WHERE payment_type='credit_card' AND payment_installments > 6 AND payment_value > 200

turns.text: How many distinct products has seller 6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0 sold?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) n FROM olist.order_items WHERE seller_id='6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0'

turns.text: And how many reviews has it received?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM olist.order_reviews r
                WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM olist.order_items WHERE seller_id='6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0')

turns.text: How many of those were 5-star?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM olist.order_reviews r
                WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM olist.order_items WHERE seller_id='6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0') AND r.review_score = 5

turns.text: How many orders came from customers in Sao Paulo state (SP)?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n FROM olist.orders o
                JOIN olist.customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state='SP'

turns.text: And from Rio de Janeiro (RJ)?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n FROM olist.orders o
                JOIN olist.customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state='RJ'

turns.text: What is the average payment value for the RJ orders?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.payment_value),2) n FROM olist.orders o
                JOIN olist.customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
                JOIN olist.order_payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE c.customer_state='RJ'

turns.text: How many orders include an item in the bed_bath_table category?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) n FROM olist.order_items oi
                JOIN olist.products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id
                JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name
                WHERE t.product_category_name_english='bed_bath_table'

turns.text: How many of those got a 5-star review?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) n FROM olist.order_items oi
                JOIN olist.products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id
                JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name
                JOIN olist.order_reviews r ON r.order_id=oi.order_id
                WHERE t.product_category_name_english='bed_bath_table' AND r.review_score=5

turns.text: And how many got a 1-star review?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) n FROM olist.order_items oi
                JOIN olist.products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id
                JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name
                JOIN olist.order_reviews r ON r.order_id=oi.order_id
                WHERE t.product_category_name_english='bed_bath_table' AND r.review_score=1

turns.text: What is the ONDC network's return window in days for the electronics category, per the returns policy?
How many electronics orders took longer than that to be delivered after purchase?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n FROM olist.orders o
                JOIN olist.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id
                JOIN olist.products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id
                JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name
                WHERE t.product_category_name_english='electronics' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
                  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp > INTERVAL '10 days'

turns.text: Just the ones where the customer is in Sao Paulo state?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n FROM olist.orders o
                JOIN olist.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id
                JOIN olist.products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id
                JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name
                JOIN olist.customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
                WHERE t.product_category_name_english='electronics' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
                  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp > INTERVAL '10 days'
                  AND c.customer_state='SP'

turns.text: How many orders include an item from seller 6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0, and how many from seller 4a3ca9315b744ce9f8e9374361493884?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT
                (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM olist.order_items WHERE seller_id='6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0') a,
                (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM olist.order_items WHERE seller_id='4a3ca9315b744ce9f8e9374361493884') b

turns.text: How many of their orders were delivered after the estimated delivery date?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n FROM olist.orders o
                JOIN olist.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id
                WHERE oi.seller_id IN ('6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0','4a3ca9315b744ce9f8e9374361493884')
                  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
                  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date
turns.note: 'their' spans two named sellers -- correctly resolvable only as BOTH combined; scored leniently, guess-rate tracked separately.

turns.text: And how many were delivered early or on time?
turns.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n FROM olist.orders o

                WHERE oi.seller_id IN ('6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0','4a3ca9315b744ce9f8e9374361493884')
